items.text: Final report: Green Bay ruled out LB Zaire Franklin (shin); G Aaron Banks, WR Bo Melton, DT Jordon Riley and CB Benjamin St-Juste are questionable. Jordan Love (back) has no designation.
Detroit lists only C Cade Mays (wrist) and S Brian Branch (Achilles) as questionable; both are expected to play, Branch without a snap count.
